title: ArEssays: Towards Robust Arabic Handwritten Text Understanding in Educational Settings
author: Hamdy Mubarak, Anas Madkoor, Ehsaneddin Asgari, Majd Hawasly

excerpt: Automated understanding of handwritten Arabic student essays remains challenging due to script complexity and high variability in children's writing. We introduce ArEssays, a large-scale dataset of authentic essays from primary to secondary students across Egypt, with both verbatim transcriptions and linguistically corrected versions. We benchmark 34 vision-language and OCR models, including fine-tuned systems, and find large performance gaps on real student handwriting. We release the dataset, training pipelines, and results to support research in Arabic OCR, document understanding, and educational NLP.
